title: Dark Mode with prefers-color-scheme Demo
title_es: Demo de Modo Oscuro con prefers-color-scheme
description: Runnable dark-mode demo: token-based CSS theming with data-theme, localStorage persistence, anti-FOUC inline script, and a system-preference listener.
description_es: Demo ejecutable de modo oscuro: tematización CSS por tokens con data-theme, persistencia en localStorage, script inline anti-FOUC y listener de preferencia del sistema.
